_comment: Operational configuration. Read by publish_latest.py, hospital_monitor.py, and get_history.py. Change values here — no Python edits required.
_section_ui: Dashboard display window — sites with scrape older than this are excluded from latest.json and history_timeline.json before publish. Bronze CSV and forecast_audit.csv are never filtered.
_section_ops: Publish gate — outside this Melbourne-local window publish_latest.py exits without pushing (Trial Mode).
_section_fidelity: Cache-lag thresholds for fidelity_status labels written to bronze_raw_scrapes.csv and forecast_audit.csv. See get_history.py module docstring for interpretation differences between html_js (Eastern Health) and powerbi (Monash Health) sources.
